draft.emotion: matter-of-fact, observing a physical detail clearly and simply
notes: 'Alto' covers both 'tall' (people, buildings, trees) and 'high' (mountains, walls, prices). Its opposite for height is 'baixo'.
Also frequently used as an adverb with verbs of speech: 'falar alto' (to speak loudly).

draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact, observing a physical detail clearly and simply
notes: When describing a person, 'alto' means tall.
When describing an object, 'alto' means high, as in a high shelf or a high mountain.
For sound, 'alto' means loud, but 'falar alto' (to speak loudly) is more common than just using the adjective alone.
